gates.name: asset-contract
command: sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight -g format 317logo.jpg | grep -q 'pixelWidth: 480' && ruby -e 'require "yaml"; x=YAML.load_file("housecall.v1.yaml"); abort "invalid OpenAPI contract" unless x["openapi"] == "3.0.0" && x["paths"].is_a?(Hash) && x["paths"].length == 60'

gates.name: server-smoke
command: PORT=43179 HOUSECALLPRO_API_KEY=test-placeholder node index.js >/tmp/carl-server-proofline.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill -TERM $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; i=0; until code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:43179/ 2>/dev/null) && [ "$code" = 404 ]; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -ge 50 ] && exit 1; sleep 0.1; done; kill -TERM $pid; wait $pid
